value.deck: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 has entered release candidate status, enabling self-hosted enterprise teams to evaluate on-premises Copilot and security feature upgrades.
shortVersion: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 is now available as a release candidate for self-hosted environments. The release introduces platform improvements while preparing on-premises infrastructure for upcoming Copilot capability additions and security enhancements.

Staging the 3.22 release candidate allows enterprise architecture teams to validate upgrade pathways and test compatibility prior to general availability. Deploying the release candidate isolates potential migration friction in self-hosted instances while verifying on-premises security feature readiness.

While the changelog confirms upcoming Copilot functionality, specific architectural parameters and technical implementation limits are omitted from the summary. Engineering teams must evaluate early release builds directly to assess how these features interface with existing self-hosted security controls.
value.plainLanguage: Self-hosted GitHub deployments can now test GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 Release Candidate to prepare for upcoming on-premises Copilot and security features.

keyTerms.meaning: A pre-release software build made available for testing and upgrade evaluation prior to final production deployment.
An enterprise installation of GitHub Enterprise Server managed within an organization's private infrastructure.

value.whyItMatters: Evaluating the release candidate allows engineering teams to identify migration risks and validate security integrations before bringing new Copilot capabilities to self-hosted enterprise environments.
